_comment: Agents registered in this connector home whose RUNTIME IS NOT A CREW FILE HERE — a chat client (Goose, Claude Desktop, VS Code) or an external integration. They are not orphans and must not be retired: `registry.serve.ghost` exists to catch a crew whose file vanished, and these never had one. Kept as a list rather than a baseline entry because the baseline may only shrink, while the next chat client appears the same way and should be added here in one line. Same shape as `crewaimeat orphans --exclude`.
_added: 2026-09-04, after the connector moved to keys and the daemon began carrying all 66 principals instead of 50 — the migration working, not something breaking. Four were retired instead (dify, openhands, scope-probe2, secretary); these twelve stay, and every one of them is an agent whose runtime is somebody else's chat program.
